title: Had + 主語 + 過去分詞
titleZh: 「Had + 主語 + 過去分詞」過去完全假設倒裝句
titleEn: Using Had + subject + past participle for an inverted third conditional

source.file: Sentence Structure 153 -「Had + 主語 + 過去分詞」過去完全假設倒裝句.pdf
omissions: English versions of Chinese-only Important Rules are faithful editorial translations.

formula: Had + subject + past participle, subject + would / could / might have + past participle

formulas.formula: Had + subject + past participle, subject + would / could / might have + past participle
Had + subject + not + past participle, subject + would / could / might have + past participle

example: Had I known about her background, I would not have made the joke.
exampleZh: 如果我早知道她的背景，便不會開那個玩笑。

examples.en: Had I known about her background, I would not have made the joke.
examples.zh: 如果我早知道她的背景，便不會開那個玩笑。
examples.highlight: Had I known about her background, I would not have made the joke.

rules.zh: 把普通第三條件句中的 if 刪除，並把 had 移到主語前面。
rules.en: Remove “if” and move “had” before the subject Standard third conditional: If I had known, I would have acted differently. Inverted third conditional: Had I known, I would have acted differently.
examples: If I had known, I would have acted differently.
Had I known, I would have acted differently.

rules.en: The verb after the subject must be a past participle Had I known Had she seen Had they arrived Had the file been saved Incorrect: Had I knew Correct: Had I known
examples: Had I known
Had she seen
Had they arrived
Had the file been saved
Incorrect: Had I knew
Correct: Had I known

rules.zh: （如果我早知道延誤，便會提早離開。）
rules.en: Use “would have” for an expected imaginary result Had I known about the delay, I would have left earlier.
examples: Had I known about the delay, I would have left earlier.

rules.zh: （如果里奧為電話充了電，他本來可以致電求助。）
rules.en: Use “could have” for past ability or opportunity Had Leo charged his phone, he could have called for help.
examples: Had Leo charged his phone, he could have called for help.

rules.zh: （如果球隊更經常練習，表現可能會更好。） Might have 表示這個結果有可能發生，但並不肯定。
rules.en: Use “might have” for an uncertain possibility Had the team practised more often, they might have performed better. Might have
examples: Had the team practised more often, they might have performed better.

rules.zh: （如果我沒有相信那些資料，便能避免這個問題。） 不要寫成：
rules.en: Put “not” after the subject Had I not trusted the information, I would have avoided the problem. Had not I trusted...
examples: Had I not trusted the information, I would have avoided the problem.
Had not I trusted...

rules.zh: 雖然 had 放在主語前面，看起來像疑問句，但它並不是問題。 意思是：
rules.en: “Had I known” is not a question Had I known, I would have helped. If I had known, I would have helped.
examples: Had I known, I would have helped.
If I had known, I would have helped.

rules.zh: 它通常表示： 某件事在過去沒有發生； 說話者正在想像另一個過去結果； 現在已經無法改變當時的情況。
rules.en: This structure refers to an unreal past. It normally indicates that something did not happen in the past, that the speaker is imagining a different past result, and that the situation can no longer be changed.

benefits.zh: 這個句型能準確表達遺憾、錯失的機會，以及「如果當時不同，結果便可能不同」的意思。 （如果我早知道截止日期，便會更早遞交表格。）
benefits.en: It expresses regret and missed opportunities precisely You can clearly explain what went wrong in the past and what would have happened under different circumstances. Had I known about the deadline, I would have submitted the form earlier.
examples: Had I known about the deadline, I would have submitted the form earlier.

benefits.zh: 你不需要每次都用 if 開始條件句，因此可以減少句式重複。
benefits.en: It gives you an alternative to repeatedly using “if” Instead of beginning every conditional sentence with if, you can use Had + subject + past participle. Compare: If the company had tested the system, it might have found the error. Had the company tested the system, it might have found the error.
examples: Instead of beginning every conditional sentence with if, you can use Had + subject + past
If the company had tested the system, it might have found the error.
Had the company tested the system, it might have found the error.

benefits.zh: 把 Had... 放在句首，可以先突出沒有發生的關鍵條件，讓讀者更容易理解事情為何出現某個結 果。
benefits.en: It draws attention to the missed condition. Placing Had ... at the beginning immediately tells the reader which unrealised past condition was important, making it easier to understand why the result occurred.

benefits.zh: 這個句型常見於作文、報告、正式解釋、演說和故事之中，可以令句式更有變化，語氣亦較成熟。
benefits.en: It can make formal writing sound more controlled This structure is especially useful in essays, reports, formal explanations, speeches and narratives.

benefits.zh: 它能把「過去沒有出現的條件」和「想像中的結果」清楚連接起來，不需要用多個零散短句解釋。
benefits.en: It helps connect a past cause and an imagined result The structure places the unreal condition and its possible result in one complete sentence.
examples: The structure places the unreal condition and its possible result in one complete sentence.

sourceOmissions: English versions of Chinese-only Important Rules are faithful editorial translations.

questions.answer: Had the villagers known the river would rise so quickly, they would have moved their belongings to higher ground.
questions.answerZh: 如果村民早知道河水會上升得這麼快，便會把財物搬到較高的地方。
questions.highlight: Had the villagers known the river would rise so quickly, they would have moved their belongings to higher ground.

questions.prompt: The teacher explained the task without an example. With an example, more students could have completed it correctly.
questions.promptZh: 老師解釋任務時沒有提供例子。如果有例子，更多學生本來可以正確完成任務。
questions.answer: Had the teacher explained the task with an example, more students could have completed it correctly.
questions.answerZh: 如果老師以例子解釋任務，更多學生本來可以正確完成任務。
questions.highlight: Had the teacher explained the task with an example, more students could have completed it correctly.

questions.prompt: I made the comment because I did not know it would upset her. If I had known, I would have chosen my words more carefully.
questions.promptZh: 我不知道那句話會令她難過，所以才那樣說。如果我知道，便會更小心選擇用詞。
questions.answer: Had I known that the comment would upset her, I would have chosen my words more carefully.
questions.answerZh: 如果我知道那句話會令她難過，便會更小心選擇用詞。
questions.highlight: Had I known that the comment would upset her, I would have chosen my words more carefully.

questions.prompt: The hospital was not informed of the power cut in advance. Advance notice could have allowed it to arrange extra generators.
questions.promptZh: 醫院沒有預先獲知停電消息。如果早獲通知，院方便能安排額外發電機。
questions.answer: Had the hospital been informed of the power cut in advance, it could have arranged extra generators.
questions.answerZh: 如果醫院預先獲知停電消息，院方便能安排額外發電機。
questions.highlight: Had the hospital been informed of the power cut in advance, it could have arranged extra generators.

questions.prompt: The council did not consider how the road closure would affect local shops. If it had considered this, it might have changed the traffic plan.
questions.promptZh: 市議會沒有考慮封路會如何影響區內店舖。如果曾考慮這一點，可能會更改交通安排。
questions.answer: Had the council considered how the road closure would affect local shops, it might have changed the traffic plan.
questions.answerZh: 如果市議會考慮過封路會如何影響區內店舖，可能會更改交通安排。
questions.highlight: Had the council considered how the road closure would affect local shops, it might have changed the traffic plan.

questions.prompt: The researchers collected data from a small group. With data from a larger group, their findings might have been more reliable.
questions.promptZh: 研究人員只從一個小組收集數據。如果從更大的群組收集數據，研究結果可能會更可靠。
questions.answer: Had the researchers collected data from a larger group, their findings might have been more reliable.
questions.answerZh: 如果研究人員從更大的群組收集數據，研究結果可能會更可靠。
questions.highlight: Had the researchers collected data from a larger group, their findings might have been more reliable.

questions.prompt: The company did not realise that demand would increase so sharply. If it had realised this, it would have ordered more stock before the holiday.
questions.promptZh: 公司沒有察覺需求會大幅上升。如果早已察覺，便會在假期前訂購更多存貨。
questions.answer: Had the company realised that demand would increase so sharply, it would have ordered more stock before the holiday.
questions.answerZh: 如果公司早已察覺需求會大幅上升，便會在假期前訂購更多存貨。
questions.highlight: Had the company realised that demand would increase so sharply, it would have ordered more stock before the holiday.

questions.prompt: The passengers were not warned about the long delay before boarding. If they had been, some of them might have changed their travel plans.
questions.promptZh: 乘客在登機前沒有獲告知航班會長時間延誤。如果獲告知，部分乘客可能會更改行程。
questions.answer: Had the passengers been warned about the long delay before boarding, some of them might have changed their travel plans.
questions.answerZh: 如果乘客在登機前獲告知航班會長時間延誤，部分乘客可能會更改行程。
questions.highlight: Had the passengers been warned about the long delay before boarding, some of them might have changed their travel plans.

questions.prompt: The rescue team did not know exactly where the hikers were. Exact location information could have helped it reach them several hours earlier.
questions.promptZh: 救援隊不知道遠足人士的確實位置。準確的位置資料本來可以讓救援隊早數小時到達。
questions.answer: Had the rescue team known exactly where the hikers were, it could have reached them several hours earlier.
questions.answerZh: 如果救援隊知道遠足人士的確實位置，便能早數小時到達他們所在之處。
questions.highlight: Had the rescue team known exactly where the hikers were, it could have reached them several hours earlier.

questions.prompt: The school changed the timetable without consulting parents. If it had consulted them first, it might have avoided many complaints.
questions.promptZh: 學校在沒有諮詢家長的情況下更改時間表。如果先諮詢家長，可能可以避免很多投訴。
questions.answer: Had the school consulted parents before changing the timetable, it might have avoided many complaints.
questions.answerZh: 如果學校在更改時間表前諮詢家長，可能可以避免很多投訴。
questions.highlight: Had the school consulted parents before changing the timetable, it might have avoided many complaints.

questions.prompt: The developers tested the app only on new phones. If they had also tested it on older phones, they would have discovered the compatibility problem before release.
questions.promptZh: 開發人員只在新款電話上測試應用程式。如果他們也在舊款電話上測試，便會在推出前發現兼容性問題。
questions.answer: Had the developers also tested the app on older phones, they would have discovered the compatibility problem before release.
questions.answerZh: 如果開發人員也在舊款電話上測試應用程式，便會在推出前發現兼容性問題。
questions.highlight: Had the developers also tested the app on older phones, they would have discovered the compatibility problem before release.

questions.prompt: The committee approved the proposal because it believed the figures were complete. If it had known they were incomplete, it would not have approved the proposal at that meeting.
questions.promptZh: 委員會以為數字完整，所以批准了建議。如果知道數字不完整，便不會在那次會議上批准建議。
questions.answer: Had the committee known that the figures were incomplete, it would not have approved the proposal at that meeting.
questions.answerZh: 如果委員會知道數字不完整，便不會在那次會議上批准建議。
questions.highlight: Had the committee known that the figures were incomplete, it would not have approved the proposal at that meeting.
